trello.name: Incident write-up for prompt injection support ticket
trello.desc: First: incident write-up. Hassan, document this attempt properly, the raw ticket, what the summarizer actually did, timestamps, and file it in the security log with a severity assessment. I want that this week. Hassan: Will do.

trello.name: Harden ticket pipeline against LLM prompt injection
trello.desc: Second, the actual fix. Wren, the ticket pipeline needs hardening: quoted customer content should be delimited and treated as data when it goes to the summarizer, with instruction-like content stripped or neutralized, and we need a regression test that feeds this exact ticket through and checks the summary stays clean. Wren: Yep. I'll add a sanitization layer in the ticket parser, delimiters plus an instruction-pattern filter, and turn this ticket into a test fixture. I'd also like to add an eval that runs a small suite of injection attempts against the summarizer on every deploy. Grace: Approved, fold the eval into the same task.

trello.name: Investigate password reset complaint for user jdoe443
trello.desc: Third: the human, if there is one, jdoe443. Buried in the injection there was an actual complaint, password reset emails not arriving. Wren, can you check whether that's a real account and whether resets are broken for anyone? Wren: I'll check the reset email delivery logs for the last week and follow up on the account. If it's a burner, we close it, if resets are actually broken, that becomes its own incident.

trello.name: Provide list of service accounts created since May for quarterly access review
trello.desc: Last item, unrelated: the quarterly access review is due Friday. I'll run the review myself, but Hassan, you owe me the list of service accounts created since May, that's your only part in it. Hassan: List of new service accounts since May, to you by Thursday.
